title: ACSeL: Adaptive Configuration Search for Hardware-Constrained LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.07570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Serving large language models (LLMs) under tight memory and latency service-level objectives (SLOs), including on edge devices, requires jointly selecting the model size, batch size, quantization algorithm, and mixed-precision quantization recipes. Exhaustive search over this combinatorially large space is infeasible. Unlike data-center serving, which often prioritizes throughput or generation speed, resource-constrained deployments typically set memory and latency budgets as constraints and then seek the configuration with the highest generation quality among feasible ones. To this end, we propose ACSeL, a framework that identifies configurations predicted to satisfy deployment constraints while achieving high predicted generation quality. translated_title: ACSeL：面向硬件受限大语言模型推理的自适应配置搜索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.07570v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在严格的内存和延迟服务级目标（SLO）下部署大语言模型（LLM）服务，包括在边缘设备上的部署，需要联合选择模型大小、批处理大小、量化算法以及混合精度量化方案。对这一组合爆炸式的巨大空间进行穷举搜索是不可行的。与通常优先考虑吞吐量或生成速度的数据中心服务不同，资源受限的部署通常将内存和延迟预算设为约束条件，然后在可行的配置中寻找生成质量最高的方案。为此，我们提出了ACSeL，一个能够识别出预测满足部署约束、同时实现高预测生成质量的配置的框架。为了实现高效的质量估计，我们使用相对模型质量退化（RMQD）作为代理指标，该指标基于候选模型与参考模型在（原文在此处截断）下一个词分布之间的散度……
tldr: ACSeL通过基于相对模型质量退化（RMQD）的代理指标，在满足内存和延迟约束的前提下，自适应地搜索大语言模型推理的最优配置组合（模型大小、批处理大小、量化方案），从而在硬件受限部署中实现最高生成质量。
en_tdlr: ACSeL is a framework that adaptively searches for optimal LLM inference configurations (model size, batch size, and quantization settings) that satisfy hardware memory and latency constraints while maximizing generation quality, using a Relative Model Quality Degradation (RMQD) proxy for efficient quality estimation.
